.github/workflows/ci.yml:
name: ci

on:
  pull_request:
  push:
    branches: [main, development]
  workflow_dispatch:

concurrency:
  group: ci-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  # Docs-only changes skip the expensive jobs. "Docs" is prose the code never reads: docs/,
  # openspec/, media/, .claude/, and Markdown outside src/ and tests/ (tests/ fixtures are code).
  # Anything else, or a diff we can't compute, runs everything.
  changes:
    name: changes
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 5
    outputs:
      code: ${{ steps.filter.outputs.code }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
      - id: filter
        env:
          BASE: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' && github.event.pull_request.base.sha || github.event.before }}
        run: |
          if [ -z "$BASE" ] || ! git cat-file -e "$BASE^{commit}" 2>/dev/null; then
            echo "no usable base ($BASE): running everything"
            echo "code=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
            exit 0
          fi
          code=$(git diff --name-only "$BASE" "$GITHUB_SHA" | awk '
            /^(docs|openspec|media|\.claude)\// { next }
            /\.md$/ && !/^(src|tests)\// { next }
            { print }')
          echo "files that need the full run:"; echo "${code:-  (none)}"
          echo "code=$([ -n "$code" ] && echo true || echo false)" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

  docs:
    # Docs-only changes still get the link and CLI-reference checks.
    name: docs
    needs: changes
    if: needs.changes.outputs.code != 'true'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 10
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - run: pipx install poetry
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: "3.12"
          cache: poetry
      - run: poetry install --no-interaction
      - run: poetry run pytest tests/test_docs.py

  lint-test:
    name: lint-test (py${{ matrix.python }})
    needs: changes
    if: needs.changes.outputs.code == 'true'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 30
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        python: ["3.11", "3.12"]
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - run: pipx install poetry
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: ${{ matrix.python }}
          cache: poetry
      # py3.12 adds the optional `ml` extra (the MODEL detector); py3.11 tests without it.
      - run: poetry install --no-interaction ${{ matrix.python == '3.12' && '--extras ml' || '' }}
      - run: poetry run ruff check .
      - run: poetry run ruff format --check .
      - run: poetry run mypy src tests tools
      - run: poetry run pytest -m "not corpus and not browser and not perf"
      - name: Verify systemd user unit
        run: |
          # verify checks that ExecStart exists; stand in for the pipx-installed binary
          mkdir -p "$HOME/.local/bin"
          printf '#!/bin/sh\nexit 0\n' > "$HOME/.local/bin/flashpoint"
          chmod +x "$HOME/.local/bin/flashpoint"
          systemd-analyze verify --user src/flashpoint/deploy/systemd/flashpoint-acquire.service

  windows:
    name: windows (py3.12)
    needs: changes
    if: needs.changes.outputs.code == 'true'
    runs-on: windows-latest
    timeout-minutes: 30
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - run: pipx install poetry
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: "3.12"
          cache: poetry
      - run: poetry install --no-interaction
      - run: poetry run ruff check .
      - run: poetry run mypy src tests tools
      - run: poetry run pytest -m "not corpus and not browser and not perf"

  clean-install:
    # The built wheel in an empty venv, with no configuration: what `pipx install` gives a team.
    name: clean install (${{ matrix.os }})
    needs: changes
    if: needs.changes.outputs.code == 'true'
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    timeout-minutes: 20
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        os: [ubuntu-latest, macos-latest, windows-latest]
    defaults:
      run:
        shell: bash
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - run: pipx install poetry
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: "3.12"
      - run: poetry build -f wheel -o "$RUNNER_TEMP/dist"
      - name: Install into a clean venv
        run: |
          python -m venv "$RUNNER_TEMP/venv"
          if [ -d "$RUNNER_TEMP/venv/Scripts" ]; then bin="$RUNNER_TEMP/venv/Scripts"; else bin="$RUNNER_TEMP/venv/bin"; fi
          "$bin/python" -m pip install --quiet "$RUNNER_TEMP"/dist/*.whl
          echo "FP_BIN=$bin" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
      - name: --version matches the package version
        run: |
          expected="flashpoint $(poetry version --short)"
          actual="$("$FP_BIN/flashpoint" --version)"
          echo "$actual"
          [ "$actual" = "$expected" ]
      - name: doctor with no configuration names flashpoint init
        working-directory: ${{ runner.temp }}  # away from the checkout's config/
        env:
          FLASHPOINT_LAKE: ${{ runner.temp }}/lake
        run: |
          set +e
          "$FP_BIN/flashpoint" doctor > doctor.txt
          code=$?
          set -e
          cat doctor.txt
          [ "$code" = 1 ]
          grep -q "no configuration in" doctor.txt
          grep -q "flashpoint init" doctor.txt

  corpus:
    name: corpus
    needs: changes
    if: needs.changes.outputs.code == 'true'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 45
    env:
      FLASHPOINT_CORPUS_DIR: ${{ github.workspace }}/.corpus
      GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}  # fetch-corpus.py downloads through gh, which needs a token
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - run: pipx install poetry
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: "3.12"
          cache: poetry
      - run: poetry install --no-interaction
      - uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: .corpus
          key: corpus-${{ hashFiles('tests/corpus/manifest.toml') }}
      - uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: ~/.cache/flashpoint/owlet
          key: owlet-${{ runner.os }}-${{ hashFiles('src/flashpoint/readers/owlet-manifest.toml') }}
      - run: poetry run python tools/fetch-corpus.py
      - name: Fetch the legacy-2025 tag (legacy migration corpus test)
        run: git fetch --depth=1 origin +refs/tags/legacy-2025:refs/tags/legacy-2025
      - name: Install rclone (restore drill)
        run: sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y rclone
      - run: poetry run pytest -m "corpus and not perf and not browser"

  browser:
    name: browser (Chromium)
    needs: changes
    if: needs.changes.outputs.code == 'true'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 30
    env:
      FLASHPOINT_CORPUS_DIR: ${{ github.workspace }}/.corpus
      GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}  # fetch-corpus.py downloads through gh, which needs a token
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - run: pipx install poetry
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: "3.12"
          cache: poetry
      - run: poetry install --no-interaction
      - run: poetry run playwright install --with-deps chromium
      - uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: .corpus
          key: corpus-${{ hashFiles('tests/corpus/manifest.toml') }}
      - uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: ~/.cache/flashpoint/owlet
          key: owlet-${{ runner.os }}-${{ hashFiles('src/flashpoint/readers/owlet-manifest.toml') }}
      - run: poetry run python tools/fetch-corpus.py
      - run: poetry run pytest -m "browser and not perf"

  perf:
    name: perf (budgets, non-blocking)
    # Not on pull requests: perf is non-blocking, so it only needs to run once a change lands.
    needs: changes
    if: github.event_name != 'pull_request' && needs.changes.outputs.code == 'true'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 45
    continue-on-error: true
    env:
      FLASHPOINT_CORPUS_DIR: ${{ github.workspace }}/.corpus
      GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}  # fetch-corpus.py downloads through gh, which needs a token
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - run: pipx install poetry
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: "3.12"
          cache: poetry
      - run: poetry install --no-interaction
      - uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: .corpus
          key: corpus-${{ hashFiles('tests/corpus/manifest.toml') }}
      - uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: ~/.cache/flashpoint/owlet
          key: owlet-${{ runner.os }}-${{ hashFiles('src/flashpoint/readers/owlet-manifest.toml') }}
      - run: poetry run python tools/fetch-corpus.py
      - run: poetry run pytest -m perf -s

  # The one required check. Skipped matrix jobs report under their unexpanded name
  # ("lint-test (py${{ matrix.python }})"), so branch protection can't require them directly.
  ci-ok:
    name: ci-ok
    if: always()
    needs: [changes, docs, lint-test, corpus]
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 5
    steps:
      - env:
          NEEDS: ${{ toJSON(needs) }}
        run: |
          echo "$NEEDS" | jq -r 'to_entries[] | "\(.key): \(.value.result)"'
          echo "$NEEDS" | jq -e '.changes.result == "success"
            and (to_entries | all(.value.result == "success" or .value.result == "skipped"))
            and (.docs.result == "success" or ."lint-test".result == "success")' >/dev/null
.github/workflows/release.yml:
name: release

# A `v*` tag builds the sdist and wheel with the version taken from the tag and publishes them
# to PyPI by trusted publishing (OIDC, no stored token). A manual run publishes a dry run to
# TestPyPI instead, under the version given.
on:
  push:
    tags: ["v*"]
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      version:
        description: "Version for the TestPyPI dry run (e.g. 0.2.0.dev1)"
        required: true

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 15
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - run: pipx install poetry
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: "3.12"
      - name: Set the version
        env:
          VERSION: ${{ github.event_name == 'push' && github.ref_name || inputs.version }}
        run: poetry version "${VERSION#v}"
      - run: poetry build
      - name: Check the wheel holds no team data and stays under 5 MB
        run: |
          python - <<'EOF'
          import pathlib, zipfile
          (wheel,) = pathlib.Path("dist").glob("*.whl")
          names = zipfile.ZipFile(wheel).namelist()
          bad = [n for n in names if "/robots/" in n or n.endswith((".wpilog", ".hoot"))]
          assert not bad, bad
          assert "flashpoint/defaults/report.toml" in names
          assert "flashpoint/web/static/index.html" in names  # the frontend ships as-is
          assert any(n.endswith(".dist-info/licenses/LICENSE") for n in names)
          assert wheel.stat().st_size < 5 * 1024 * 1024, wheel.stat().st_size
          EOF
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: dist
          path: dist/

  pypi:
    if: github.event_name == 'push'
    needs: build
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    environment:
      name: pypi
      url: https://pypi.org/p/flashpoint
    permissions:
      id-token: write
    steps:
      - uses: actions/download-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: dist
          path: dist/
      - uses: pypa/gh-action-pypi-publish@release/v1

  testpypi:
    if: github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch'
    needs: build
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    environment:
      name: testpypi
      url: https://test.pypi.org/p/flashpoint
    permissions:
      id-token: write
    steps:
      - uses: actions/download-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: dist
          path: dist/
      - uses: pypa/gh-action-pypi-publish@release/v1
        with:
          repository-url: https://test.pypi.org/legacy/
